findings.title: Container running as root
findings.message: Dockerfile does not specify a non-root USER instruction.

findings.title: Missing prevent_destroy lifecycle protection on stateful resource
findings.message: Stateful resource 'aws_db_instance.production_db' does not have 'lifecycle { prevent_destroy = true }' configured.
findings.suggested_fix: Add 'lifecycle { prevent_destroy = true }' block inside the 'aws_db_instance' declaration.

findings.title: Missing container resource limits
findings.message: Container 'api' in Deployment 'web-service' is missing CPU and/or memory resource limits.

findings.title: Missing dependency caching
findings.message: Step 'Setup Node.js' uses actions/setup-node@v4 without caching enabled.
findings.suggested_fix: Add 'with: cache: npm' to cache dependencies and speed up CI runs.
